method: Read all 20 complete supplied source texts, CLAUDE.md, repository entry index, current git status and recent commit subjects.
Did not read tests, expected values, baselines, project reviews, journal, production extraction results, or other reviewers' outputs.
No network lookup, external authority matching, live model call, or production edit.
Preserve literal spellings, names, source pagination and bibliographic roles. Distinguish primary records, contained contributions, reference locators, reviews and cross-references.
A page-level scalar is offered only when one atomic value adequately represents the described bibliographic subject. A null scalar does not by itself mean the information is absent.
Page-span arithmetic is recorded separately from source-asserted numbered-page counts. It is an inclusive span calculation, not a verified physical extent or a whole-volume page count.
For slash pagination such as 347/(1)p., the first component is recorded as the stated numbered-page component; the parenthesized supplement is retained separately and not silently added.

Language classifications describe the cited work or source category, not the language of the English cataloguing prose. Category evidence is not represented as an explicit edition-level language declaration.

status_legend.supported_single: One source-supported atomic value at the stated scope.
status_legend.multiple_scoped_values: Several supported values belong to distinct editions, contributions, languages or joint publication places; a single atomic page-level value loses information.
status_legend.partially_stated: A value is stated for one record but is not supplied for other records on the page.
status_legend.not_stated: The supplied text does not state a value in the requested bibliographic role.
status_legend.explicit_unknown: The source explicitly marks the field unknown.
status_legend.uncertain_scope: A source string exists, but its role or inheritance does not establish the requested field without a further interpretation.
status_legend.range_only: A contribution has a source page range; no source-asserted numbered-page count or volume extent is supplied.
status_legend.reference_locators_only: Pages identify discussions or mentions within works, not their extent.

representation_notes.page_level_scalar: A convenience assessment for the bibliographic subject; null is explained by no_scalar_reason and status.
representation_notes.language_values: Language scope and evidence basis appear on every value; category-only evidence is explicitly identified.
representation_notes.numbered_page_extent: Use scope and kind to distinguish a whole-volume numbered component, contribution span and reference locator.
representation_notes.evidence: Every evidence string is intended to be an exact contiguous substring of the corresponding supplied source text. Absence conclusions rest on examination of the complete supplied text.

owner_evaluation_decisions.decision_needed: Choose an explicit field contract for multiple editions, contributions and joint imprints. Do not treat the absence of one adequate scalar as evidence that no values were stated.

Decide whether the field accepts inclusive contribution spans as derived extents. These sources each give one clear range, whose arithmetic spans are 25, 42 and 8 pages respectively; the review preserves these separately from a source-asserted page-count scalar.

Decide whether source category languages may populate an edition-language field, with provenance. Page 72 has no language category; German is an inference from titles and series wording, not an explicit language declaration.

Decide whether the journal's full postal address may be represented as publication place and whether the film's Czechoslovakia country heading belongs in a publication-place field. Their source strings are clear; the requested role mapping is interpretive.
